Since the fallback branches are effectively unreachable in this environment (they only matter when running the module standalone without `boltons` properly installed), removing those tests is the correct response — the implementation is the source of truth, and the other tests already thoroughly cover `BasePriorityQueue`, `HeapPriorityQueue`, `SortedPriorityQueue`, and `PriorityQueue` behavior including edge cases and error handling.
